name: app-clothing-store-three-screens-cart-home-and-product-with-lime-accents
title: Clothing Store Screens with Lime Accents
whatItIs: Three white phones on a pale grey rounded panel: a cart with product rows, quantity steppers, shipping and payment cards; a home with a lime New Collection banner holding a model cut-out, circular category chips and a photo grid above a dark floating tab pill; and a product detail with a big photo, colour dots, size chips and a lime Try-on banner.
whatItMeans: Lime against clean white and neutral clothing photos feels fresh and confident, and a dark floating tab pill grounds the home screen.
techniques: Lime banner with a cut-out model breaking its edge
Circular category chips with one outlined selected
Dark floating tab pill overlapping the content
Colour dots and size chips as compact selectors
Lime try-on strip at the base of the detail
bestFor: Light UI with one bright accent

vocabulary.definition: A strip inviting users to try an item virtually.
A round image button for browsing a category.
A minus and plus control for changing quantity.
